svg.text: NIC-Strelka — Materinka, Kryska's board: its parts and their nets, from BOARD.md (not a schematic)

Flat: every pin ends in its net's name; a red cross is a pin left unconnected. The core — the contact, U2 the PMIC, the magnets, the light, the cell — the same on the three boards. Drawn by board/nets.py.
U1 — Fanstel BM20M, the nRF54LM20A module
U2 — Nordic nPM1300, the PMIC; BUCK2 at 3,0 V
U3 — CS CSNP1GCR01-BOW, SD NAND of 1 Gbit, in SPI mode — Kryska
U6 — TI TPS7A2030, LDO 3,0 V, +3V0_SD — the Belka and Kryska
5-pin magnetic contact: 1 VBUS · 2 D+ · 3 GND · 4 D− · 5 VBUS
BUCK2 — Kryska's buck and its filter
+3V0_SD — U6's rail, the Belka's card, Kryska's SD NAND
2,2 µF 16 V 0603, at U3, the SD NAND's own
VBUS_MOD — U2's VBUSOUT, the processor's USB supply
BAT — the cell's plus, and magnet A
JST SH, 1,0 mm, SM03B-SRSS-TB or a like one: BAT · GND · NTC
DRV5032ZE, magnet A: 1 VCC BAT · 2 OUT · 3 GND
+3V0 — the board's rail: U5's on the Belka and Povodok, the filter's on Kryska
DRV5032ZE, magnet B: 1 VCC rail · 2 OUT · 3 GND
VSYS — the power path's output, and the light
10 µF 50 V 1206, at U2's VSYS and PVDD
10 µF 50 V 1206, at U2's PVDD, to PVSS2
1,5 kΩ — the red's current, some 1 mA
1,5 kΩ — the green's current, some 1 mA
+3V0_IMU — the sensor's supply, a π, and its resistors
Licence: CERN-OHL-P v2. The values and the parts: BOARD.md; the sources: PARTS.md.
